title: Domain depends on an outer layer
guidance: The domain must not import application, infrastructure or api. Invert the dependency with a domain port.

title: Domain depends on a framework / infrastructure technology
guidance: Keep the domain free of persistence, messaging, HTTP and cloud SDKs.

title: Application layer depends on infrastructure
guidance: Application services orchestrate through domain ports, never concrete adapters.

title: Application layer uses a repository port directly
guidance: Go through a domain service that encapsulates the lookup or persistence.

title: API layer bypasses the application layer
guidance: Controllers should delegate to application services.
